headline: 46 changes affect CPSC-watched codes
overview: HTS 2026HTSRev11 compared with 2026HTSRev10: 333 changes, 104 of them relevant to CPSC. By relevance: Tier 1 (covered) 46, needs review 51, Tier 2 (near a rule) 7, not relevant 229. By type: added 214, renumbered 43, possible_split 31, desc_changed 30, split 12, rate_changed 3. 12 watched codes were removed, split or renumbered; CPSC targeting may need updating.

top_changes.summary: Code 3818.00.00.95 (Chemical elements doped for use in electronics, in the form of discs, wafers or similar f…) was split into 3818.00.00.50 and 3818.00.00.91.
Code 3926.90.99.10 (Other: Laboratory ware) was removed, and new codes 3926.90.99.15 and 3926.90.99.20 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.
Code 7113.19.29.00 (Necklaces and neck chains, of gold: Other) was renumbered to 7113.19.29.90.
Code 8307.10.60.00 (Of iron or steel: Other) was renumbered to 8307.10.60.60.
Code 8424.30.90.00 (Steam or sand blasting machines and similar jet projecting machines: Other) was renumbered to 8424.30.90.90.

Code 8424.90.90.40 (Other: Of steam and similar jet projecting machines) was removed, and new codes 8424.90.90.10 and 8424.90.90.20 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.

Code 8504.40.95.70 (Other: Inverters) was removed, and new codes 8504.40.95.71, 8504.40.95.73, 8504.40.95.75, 8504.40.95.77, 8504.40.95.78 and 8504.40.95.79 appeared in the same group; they may replace it, so a person should check.
